purpose: Freeze the first rigorous AFK radical-annihilation test for the d=12,f=3 overlap pilot.

target.selection_rule: The lexicographically first stored radical basis vector in tcc-flat-monoid-p1-overlap-adapter-v1.json.
target.zero_class_rule: The monoid element 0 is the zero class, whose differenced partial zeta derivative is zero by Kopp's zero-class proposition.

formula: Z'_12infinity2(A_3)=-2*sum_{w in w_cycle} log(Sin_2(w,beta)); the factor 2 is the one-place fiber cardinality because O_3 has no negative-norm unit.

enclosure_policy.required_margin: The resulting interval for Z'_12infinity2(A_3) must exclude zero.
enclosure_policy.failure_rule: If any enclosure or source-hypothesis check fails, retain the failed artifact and make no radical conclusion.
